name: Alakazam
power_text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another as long as you don't Knock Out that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
flavor_text: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

name: Blastoise
power_text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach 1 Water Energy card to 1 of your Water Pokémon. (This doesn't use up your 1 Energy card attachment for the turn.) This power can't be used if Blastoise is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
attack1_text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Water Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.
flavor_text: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

name: Chansey
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Chansey during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
attack2_text: Chansey does 80 damage to itself.
flavor_text: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

name: Charizard
power_text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into Fire Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
attack1_text: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.
flavor_text: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

name: Clefairy
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
attack2_text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack, such as discarding Energy cards. (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Clefairy's type is still Colorless.)
flavor_text: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

name: Gyarados
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

name: Machamp
power_text: Whenever your opponent's attack damages Machamp (even if Machamp is Knocked Out), this power does 10 damage to the attacking Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power can't be used if Machamp is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when your opponent attacks.
flavor_text: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

name: Magneton
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attack2_text: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magneton does 80 damage to itself.
flavor_text: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

name: Mewtwo
attack1_text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
attack2_text: Discard 1 Psychic Energy card attached to Mewtwo in order to prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Mewtwo during your opponent's next turn.
flavor_text: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Nidoking
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage and Nidoking does 10 damage to itself.
attack2_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).
flavor_text: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

name: Ninetales
attack1_text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.
attack2_text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Ninetales in order to use this attack.
flavor_text: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Poliwrath
attack1_text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Poliwrath but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Water Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.
attack2_text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.
flavor_text: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

name: Raichu
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Raichu.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If tails, Raichu does 30 damage to itself.
flavor_text: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Venusaur
power_text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Grass Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. This power can't be used if Venusaur is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
flavor_text: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Zapdos
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If tails, Zapdos does 30 damage to itself.
attack2_text: Discard all Energy cards attached to Zapdos in order to use this attack.
flavor_text: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

name: Beedrill
attack1_text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Dragonair
attack1_text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
attack2_text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

name: Dugtrio
attack2_text: Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage plus Electabuzz does 10 damage to itself.
flavor_text: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

attack1_text: Flip a coin. If tails, Electrode does 10 damage to itself.
flavor_text: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

attack2_text: If Pidgeotto was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Pidgeotto to the Defending Pokémon.
flavor_text: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Arcanine
attack1_text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Arcanine in order to use this attack.
attack2_text: Arcanine does 30 damage to itself.
flavor_text: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

name: Charmeleon
attack2_text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Charmeleon in order to use this attack.
flavor_text: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

name: Dewgong
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

name: Farfetch'd
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, you can't use this attack again as long as Farfetch'd stays in play (even putting Farfetch'd on the Bench won't let you use it again).
flavor_text: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

name: Haunter
attack1_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attack2_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attack2_text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

attack1_text: Discard 1 Psychic Energy card attached to Kadabra in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Kadabra.

name: Magikarp

name: Magmar
attack2_text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Magmar in order to use this attack.

name: Nidorino
attack1_text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attack2_text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

name: Raticate
attack2_text: Does damage to the Defending Pokémon equal to half the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP (rounded up to the nearest 10).
flavor_text: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

name: Seel
flavor_text: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Wartortle

name: Abra
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

name: Caterpie
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

attack2_text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Charmander in order to use this attack.
flavor_text: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

name: Doduo
attack1_text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
flavor_text: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

name: Drowzee
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attack2_text: Discard 1 Psychic Energy card attached to Gastly in order to use this attack. If a Pokémon Knocks Out Gastly during your opponent's next turn, Knock Out that Pokémon.

name: Koffing
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned; if tails, it is now Confused.
flavor_text: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

flavor_text: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Nidoran ♂
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
flavor_text: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

name: Onix
attack2_text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or less damage is done to Onix (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
flavor_text: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

name: Pidgey
attack1_text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)
flavor_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pikachu
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If tails, Pikachu does 10 damage to itself.
flavor_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

name: Poliwag
attack1_text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Poliwag but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Water Energy after the 2nd don't count.
flavor_text: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: Sandshrew
attack1_text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Squirtle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Voltorb

name: Vulpix
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Fearow.

attack1_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavor_text: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool; it is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Nidorina
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
attack2_text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

name: Parasect
attack1_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
flavor_text: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

name: Persian
attack2_text: If the Defending Pokémon attacks Persian during your next turn, any damage done by the attack is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)
flavor_text: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Primeape
attack1_text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If tails, Primeape is now Confused (after doing damage).
flavor_text: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until its quarry is caught.

attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Rapidash.
flavor_text: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

attack2_text: Rhydon does 20 damage to itself. If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon. Switch the Pokémon even if Rhydon is knocked out.)
flavor_text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

name: Seaking
flavor_text: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

name: Tauros
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.
attack2_text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Tauros. Flip a coin. If tails, Tauros is now Confused (after doing damage).
flavor_text: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Weepinbell
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
flavor_text: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

name: Bellsprout
attack2_text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon named Bellsprout and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)
flavor_text: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

name: Cubone
attack1_text: If the Defending Pokémon attacks Cubone during your opponent's next turn, any damage done by the attack is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)
attack2_text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Cubone.
flavor_text: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

name: Eevee
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack Eevee during your opponent's next turn. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.
flavor_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from elemental stones.

name: Exeggcute
attack1_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
attack2_text: Unless all damage from this attack is prevented, you may remove 1 damage counter from Exeggcute.
flavor_text: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Goldeen
flavor_text: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname "Water Queen."

name: Jigglypuff
attack1_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
flavor_text: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

flavor_text: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next.

name: Meowth
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.
flavor_text: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

attack2_text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon named Nidoran ♂ or Nidoran ♀ and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)
flavor_text: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Oddish
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attack2_text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon named Oddish and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)
flavor_text: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

name: Paras
attack2_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

name: Pikachu
attack1_text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
flavor_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Rhyhorn
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack Rhyhorn during your opponent's next turn. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)
flavor_text: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

name: Spearow
attack2_text: If Spearow was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Spearow to the Defending Pokémon.

name: Venonat
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attack2_text: Remove a number of damage counters from Venonat equal to the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attack2_text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

attack2_text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.
flavor_text: It holds its egg carefully when moving so as not to break it. Still, it is fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye.

name: Dark Croconaw
attack1_text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)
flavor_text: It has 49 teeth in its mouth that are constantly replacing themselves. Pull one out, and a new one grows in.

name: Dark Exeggutor
attack1_text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
attack2_text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards attached to your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
flavor_text: If one of its heads falls off, it turns into an Exeggcute, which begins to look for other Exeggcutes using a special form of telepathy.

name: Dark Flaaffy
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play Trainer cards during his or her next turn.
attack2_text: If the Defending Pokémon has a Pokémon Power, that power stops working until the end of your next turn.
flavor_text: As a result of storing massive amounts of electricity there, it can no longer grow wool on certain areas of its body.

name: Dark Forretress
attack1_text: Until the end of your next turn, if Dark Forretress would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, Dark Forretress is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead.
attack2_text: Dark Forretress does 60 damage to itself.
flavor_text: It stays motionless in trees, driving away with flying armored shards from its hard shell any who come close.

name: Dark Haunter
attack1_text: Put a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile onto his or her Bench. Put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
flavor_text: It silently hunts its prey in dark rooms.

name: Dark Omanyte
attack1_text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage for each Water Energy card attached to Dark Omanyte. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. You can't do more than 30 damage in this way.
flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon possessed 10 tentacles, which it used to swim through the ocean.

name: Dark Pupitar
attack1_text: Dark Pupitar does 10 damage to itself. Dark Pupitar can't use this attack during your next turn.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Then, search your deck for an Evolution card named Dark Tyranitar and put it on Dark Pupitar. (This counts as evolving Dark Pupitar.) Shuffle your deck afterward.
flavor_text: It is encased within a hard shell, yet retains a great deal of mobility—a dangerous combination.

name: Dark Quilava
attack1_text: Show the top card of your opponent's deck to all players. If it's a Trainer card, discard it.
attack2_text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. (If there are fewer than 5 cards in your deck, discard all of them.) This attack does 20 damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded in this way.
flavor_text: If it turns its back to an opponent, it is a sign that it is getting ready to attack.

name: Dark Wigglytuff
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
attack2_text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep or Confused, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. Then, the Defending Pokémon is no longer Asleep or Confused.
flavor_text: This Pokémon has soft, fine hair. When angered, it increases in size and has been known to charge those it considers a threat.

name: Heracross
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage.
flavor_text: It is normally peaceful, but will attack any who get between it and honey, its favorite food.

name: Hitmonlee
attack1_text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
flavor_text: It has a perfect sense of balance and can lash out with powerful kicks from any position.

name: Houndour
attack1_text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
flavor_text: When night falls, the air fills with the eerie cries of this Pokémon as it stakes out its territory.

name: Jigglypuff
attack1_text: All damage done to Jigglypuff during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
flavor_text: If puffs its body up like a balloon and sings a lullaby that makes all who hear it fall into a deep sleep.

name: Light Dewgong
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
attack2_text: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as Light Dewgong is your Active Pokémon, prevent all damage done by attacks to your Benched Pokémon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
flavor_text: It has an aerodynamic shape that allows it to swim at great speeds. The colder the water gets, the more active it becomes.

name: Light Flareon
attack1_text: If you have any benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of them. Then shuffle your deck.
attack2_text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to Light Flareon or this attack does nothing. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 damage for each heads.
flavor_text: It creates its flames by swallowing air into a special pouch within its body, then heating it to over 3000 degrees.

name: Light Golduck
attack1_text: Your opponent looks at the top 3 cards of his or her deck. If any of them are basic Energy cards, he or she may show any number of them to you and put them into his or her hand. You do the same. Either way, each player shuffles his or her deck.
attack2_text: This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Special Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
flavor_text: The faster it swims, the brighter the glow on its forehead becomes.

name: Light Jolteon
attack1_text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or more damage is done to Light Jolteon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
attack2_text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: It can collect the ambient electrical energy in its cells and expel it in massive bursts.

name: Light Machoke
attack1_text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, shuffle 1 of them and all cards attached to it into your deck.
attack2_text: If the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage. If it has any, this attack does 20 damage.
flavor_text: This Pokémon never gets tired, no matter what it does or how hard it works.

name: Light Ninetales
attack1_text: Put a Baby Pokémon or a Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)
attack2_text: Discard a Fire Energy card attached to Light Ninetales in order to use this attack.
flavor_text: It is said that each of its nine tails contains a different magical power.

name: Light Slowbro
attack1_text: Your opponent may choose up to 3 Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, and/or Evolution cards from his or her discard pile and shuffle them into his or her deck. Either way, you may do the same.
attack2_text: If there are more Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon than to Light Slowbro, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. If not, this attack does 20 damage.
flavor_text: If the Shellder attached to its tail becomes separated, this Pokémon reverts to a normal Slowpoke.

name: Light Vaporeon
attack1_text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon and discard all Energy cards attached to it.
attack2_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. Remove 1 damage counter from each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it.
flavor_text: If its fins being to vibrate, it is a sign that it will begin raining soon.

name: Light Venomoth
attack1_text: Your opponent may choose a Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, or Evolution card from his or her discard pile and put it into his or her hand. Either way, you may do the same.
attack2_text: If Light Venomoth and the Defending Pokémon have a different number of Energy cards attached to them, this attack does nothing.
flavor_text: It defends itself by flapping its wings at high speed, spreading poisonous powder throughout the air.

name: Light Wigglytuff
attack1_text: Your opponent may choose 1 of his or her Pokémon and search his or her deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon. Your opponent attaches that card to that Pokémon. This counts as evolving that Pokémon. Either way, you may do the same, and then each player who searched shuffles his or her deck.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: If two of them brush against each other, they will not be able to separate themselves, as they enjoy touching each other's soft fur too much.

name: Scyther
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Scyther.
flavor_text: It moves so fast as to be invisible to the naked eye. Even when standing still, its camouflage prevents it from being seen.

name: Togepi
attack1_text: If the Defending Pokémon attacks during your opponent's next turn, any damage it does is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
attack2_text: Togepi does 10 damage to itself.
flavor_text: Its shell is said to contain happiness itself, which it will share with those who are kind to it.

name: Unown [C]
power_text: As long as Unown [C] is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon tries to retreat, flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. Apply Weakness and Resistance.
flavor_text: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [P]
power_text: If an attack damaged Unown [P] during your opponent's last turn and Unown [P] was your Active Pokémon, Unown [P]'s Hidden Power attack does that much more damage to the Defending Pokémon. This power can be used even if Unown [P] is Confused.
flavor_text: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [Q]
power_text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to any of your Pokémon with Unown in its name during your opponent's next turn. If you have more than 1 Unown [Q] in play, use only 1 [Quicken] each turn. This power can be used even if Unown [Q] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
flavor_text: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [Z]
power_text: As long as Unown [Z] is Benched, you pay no Energy cost to retreat a Pokémon with Unown in its name.
flavor_text: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Cyndaquil
attack1_text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
flavor_text: It is very meek and constantly crouches in a defensive posture. When threatened, it protects itself with the flame on its back.

name: Dark Octillery
attack1_text: This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to Dark Octillery but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, during your opponent's next turn, your opponent pays Colorless more to retreat the Defending Pokémon.
flavor_text: It likes to sleep in rock caves and will even steal other Octillery's nests.

name: Dratini
attack1_text: Remove 1 damage counter from Dratini.
attack2_text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
flavor_text: Large from birth, this Pokémon increases in size throughout its life by regularly shedding its skin.

name: Exeggcute
attack1_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: Its shell is very durable, allowing it to survive even if the shell becomes cracked.

name: Gastly
attack1_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
flavor_text: Its gas-like body allows it to enter almost anywhere, but it is vulnerable to high winds.

name: Girafarig
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.
attack2_text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
flavor_text: Its tail has a brain of its own, which can respond to stimuli such as scents. Many unsuspecting people have been bitten by it.

name: Gligar
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.
flavor_text: It spends its days hanging from cliffs, swooping down on any prey it spots from its high vantage point.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: It fears nothing, not even opponents larger than itself.

name: Hitmonchan
attack1_text: If Hitmonchan would be damaged by an attack during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that attack's damage done to Hitmonchan. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
flavor_text: Its punches are blindingly fast, but it can only fight for three minutes before tiring and needing to rest.

name: Larvitar
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)
flavor_text: It is born deep within the ground and has to burrow its way out.

name: Ledyba
attack1_text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.
flavor_text: Sensitive to cold, Ledyba gather in groups to share warmth when the temperature drops.

name: Light Sunflora
attack1_text: Attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Grass Pokémon.
flavor_text: Although it is extremely active during the day, it stops moving entirely as soon as the sun sets.

name: Machop
flavor_text: When bored, this super-strong Pokémon trains by lifting rocks.

name: Mantine
attack1_text: Mantine can't attack during your next turn.
flavor_text: This Pokémon is perfectly adapted to its ocean home. It can gather up enough speed to burst above the water like a whale.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: Its soft wool coat captures air, allowing it to remain cool during the summer and warm in the winter.

name: Phanpy
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.
flavor_text: It hits people with its nose as a sign of affection but doesn't know its own strength and so sometimes knocks people off their feet.

name: Pineco
flavor_text: It waits suspended from tree branches for insects to fly into its mouth, often not moving for hours at a time.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: This Pokémon was created by human computer engineering. Its program is only capable of simple action and reaction.

name: Psyduck
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, Psyduck is now Confused.
flavor_text: Although possessed of great mental powers, it doesn't know how to use them.

name: Remoraid
attack1_text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
flavor_text: It can shoot a burst of water from its mouth to propel itself backward at high speeds, allowing it to flee from surprised enemies.

name: Seel
attack1_text: Seel does 10 damage to itself.
flavor_text: Although clumsy on land, it moves easily through the arctic waters it calls home.

name: Slugma
flavor_text: This Pokémon is often seen crawling around in volcanic regions.

name: Sunkern
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from Sunkern. Search your deck for a card that evolves from Sunkern and attach that card to Sunkern. This counts as evolving Sunkern. Shuffle your deck afterward.
flavor_text: It is very small and powerless. If attacked, the best it can do is flap its leaves in an attempt to frighten away its enemies.

name: Swinub
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: It moves with its sensitive nose pressed to the ground, always searching for food.

name: Totodile
attack1_text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Totodile but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.
flavor_text: Its highly developed jaws are powerful enough to crush anything. Even experienced adult trainers must handle it with great caution.

name: Unown [L]
power_text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, each player shuffles his or her deck. This power can be used even if Unown [L] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
flavor_text: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [S]
power_text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at 1 of your Prize cards. Return that Prize card face down. This power can be used even if Unown [S] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
flavor_text: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [T]
power_text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand and show your hand to your opponent. This power can be used even if Unown [T] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
flavor_text: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [V]
power_text: When you play Unown [V] from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name (other than Unown [V]) to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)
flavor_text: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Venonat
attack2_text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
flavor_text: It possesses a type of radar, which it can use to find the insects it eats for food, even in pitch darkness.

name: Vulpix
attack1_text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Vulpix in order to use this attack.
flavor_text: As it grows older, its white tail changes colors and splits into six different tails. Its body radiates a faint warmth.

name: Shining Celebi
attack1_text: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon equal to the number of Water Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.
attack2_text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).
flavor_text: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.

name: Shining Charizard
attack1_text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card and 1 Lightning Energy card attached to Shining Charizard or this attack does nothing. Flip a coin. If tails, Shining Charizard does 30 damage to itself.
flavor_text: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.

name: Shining Kabutops
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does 30 damage and Shining Kabutops does 10 damage to itself.
attack2_text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Shining Kabutops but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Don't apply Resistance.
flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

name: Shining Mewtwo
attack1_text: If an attack does damage to Shining Mewtwo during your opponent's next turn (even if Shining Mewtwo is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Shining Mewtwo from that attack (any other effects of attacks still happen) and do 20 damage to the attacking Pokémon.
attack2_text: Discard a Fire Energy card attached to Shining Mewtwo or this attack does nothing. This attack does 40 damage plus 10 damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
flavor_text: It uses its highly developed psychic powers to defeat its enemies before they even have time to think.

name: Shining Noctowl
attack1_text: Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If exactly 2 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If all 3 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: It speeds up its thought processes by turning its head around 180 degrees.

name: Shining Raichu
attack1_text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon for each Water Energy attached to Shining Raichu. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
flavor_text: If the electricity in its cheeks runs out, it sticks its tail straight up and uses it to collect energy from the air.

name: Shining Steelix
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, Shining Steelix can't attack during your next turn.
flavor_text: If an Onix lives 100 years or more, its skin hardens, eventually becoming even harder than a diamond.

name: Shining Tyranitar
attack1_text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, your opponent discards the top card from his or her deck.
attack2_text: Flip a coin for each Fire Energy card attached to Shining Tyranitar. For each heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to Shining Tyranitar or this attack does nothing. Then, for each heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and discard it. If it has fewer Energy cards than that, remove all of them.
flavor_text: It is so powerful, it can knock down a mountain with hust one arm.

name: Mew
attack1_text: Choose a type of Energy other than Colorless attached to Mew. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon of that type (including Benched Pokémon). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.
flavor_text: This Pokémon's body is covered by fine hairs that can be seen only under a microscope.

name: Pidgeot
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
flavor_text: This Pokémon searches for food while flying at Mach 2. Its large claws make fearsome weapons.

name: Onix
attack1_text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: This Pokémon burrows through the earth at high speed, looking for food. The tunnels it digs are used by Diglett as nests.

name: Togepi
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
flavor_text: This Pokémon is still immature. When threatened, it releases poison from its head and tries to drive its enemies away.

name: Ivysaur
attack1_text: Each player flips a coin. Each player who gets heads chooses a total of 3 damage counters from among his or her Pokémon and removes them. (If the player's Pokémon have fewer total damage counters than that, he or she removes all of them.)
flavor_text: A sure sign spring is on its way is when the seed on this Pokémon's back flowers.

name: Raticate
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.
flavor_text: This Pokémon sometimes hunts for food in rivers, swimming using the small webs between the toes on its rear legs.

name: Ledyba
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Ledyba.
flavor_text: When it senses enemies approaching, this Pokémon releases an orange fluid from the joints in its legs and flees.

name: Jigglypuff
attack1_text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
flavor_text: After lulling its enemies with its large eyes, this Pokémon sings them to sleep with a relaxing melody.

name: Butterfree
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Butterfree. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
flavor_text: The poison scales on its wings are waterproof, allowing this Pokémon to be active even on rainy days.

name: Tentacruel
attack1_text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Water Energy attached to Tentacruel. For each heads, draw 2 cards.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: This Pokémon attacks its prey with its eighty toxin-producing tentacles.

name: Marill
attack1_text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.
flavor_text: This Pokémon's fur repels water like a duck's feathers, allowing it to stay dry and fluffy even in water.

name: Lapras
attack1_text: If Lapras has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). If the Defending Pokémon has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
flavor_text: This gentle Pokémon can understand human language and allows people to ride on its back.

name: Exeggutor
attack1_text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Grass Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.
flavor_text: This Pokémon has a unique cry, as all three of its heads are always talking independently of one another.

name: Slowking
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
attack2_text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
flavor_text: Its nonchalant reaction to everything somehow gives this Pokémon an imposing presence.

name: Wartortle
attack1_text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Wartortle but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.
flavor_text: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

name: Lickitung
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) with damage counters on it and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1).
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.
flavor_text: This Pokémon uses its six-foot tongue as if it were a hand. The origin of its anaesthetic properties is still a mystery.

name: Vileplume
attack1_text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 2 damage counters from Vileplume (1 if it only has 1). Then, if you have any Benched Pokémon with damage counters on them, choose 1 of them and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1).
attack2_text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes a loud jangling noise when it shakes its petals to spread poison powder.

name: Primeape
attack2_text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Primeape. Flip a coin. If tails, Primeape is now Confused (after doing damage).
flavor_text: This Pokémon only calms down when there are no other animals or people around—which means no one has ever seen it when it's not angry.
